title: 第27课 · 你在找什么呢
subtitle: Lesson 27 — 你在找什么呢 · What are you looking for

items.en: in the process of; right now doing

items.py: Wǒ zài zhǎo wǒ de yàoshi.

items.en: He's on the phone right now.

items.zh: 刘京：大卫，你在找什么呢？
items.py: Liú Jīng: Dàwèi, nǐ zài zhǎo shénme ne?
items.en: Liu Jing: David, what are you looking for?

items.py: Dàwèi: Wǒ zài zhǎo wǒ de yàoshi.
items.en: David: I'm looking for my keys.

items.py: Liú Jīng: Nǐ de yàoshi diū le?
items.en: Liu Jing: You lost your keys?

items.zh: 大卫：不知道放在哪儿了。
items.py: Dàwèi: Bù zhīdào fàng zài nǎr le.
items.en: David: I don't know where I put them.

items.py: Liú Jīng: Shì bu shì zài shūbāo lǐ?
items.en: Liu Jing: Could they be in your backpack?

items.zh: 大卫：让我看看。找到了！谢谢你！
items.py: Dàwèi: Ràng wǒ kànkan. Zhǎodào le! Xièxie nǐ!
items.en: David: Let me check. Found them! Thanks!

data.topic: 会话2 · Dialogue 2 (What are you doing?)

items.py: Tóngxué: Zài. Tā zhèngzài kàn shū ne.
items.en: Classmate: Yes. She's reading right now.

items.zh: 玛丽：和子，我们出去散步吧。
items.py: Mǎlì: Hézǐ, wǒmen chūqù sànbù ba.
items.en: Mary: Hezi, let's go for a walk.

items.zh: 和子：现在不行，外面正在下雨呢。
items.py: Hézǐ: Xiànzài bù xíng, wàimiàn zhèngzài xià yǔ ne.
items.en: Hezi: Not now, it's raining outside.

items.zh: 玛丽：那我们在宿舍聊天儿吧。
items.py: Mǎlì: Nà wǒmen zài sùshè liáotiānr ba.
items.en: Mary: Then let's chat in the dorm.

items.zh: 和子：好啊。你在学什么呢？
items.py: Hézǐ: Hǎo a. Nǐ zài xué shénme ne?
items.en: Hezi: Sure. What are you studying?

items.zh: 玛丽：我在准备明天的考试。
items.py: Mǎlì: Wǒ zài zhǔnbèi míngtiān de kǎoshì.
items.en: Mary: I'm preparing for tomorrow's exam.

data.topic: 语法 · Grammar (正在/在...呢 Progressive)

items.en: He's eating right now. (正在...呢 = in progress)

items.zh: 你在做什么呢？——我在写作业呢。
items.py: Nǐ zài zuò shénme ne? —— Wǒ zài xiě zuòyè ne.
items.en: What are you doing? — I'm doing homework.

items.zh: 你在做什么呢？——我在看书呢。
items.py: Nǐ zài zuò shénme ne? —— Wǒ zài kàn shū ne.
items.en: What are you doing? — I'm reading.

items.zh: 你在做什么呢？——我在听音乐呢。
items.py: Nǐ zài zuò shénme ne? —— Wǒ zài tīng yīnyuè ne.

items.zh: 你在做什么呢？——我在写信呢。
items.py: Nǐ zài zuò shénme ne? —— Wǒ zài xiě xìn ne.
Wǒ zài zhǎo wǒ de yàoshi.
Wǒ zài zhǎo wǒ de shǒujī.
Wǒ zài zhǎo wǒ de qiánbāo.
